items.quote: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek:
items.claim: Moses tells Joshua to choose men and go out to fight Amalek.
items.object: Joshua to choose men and fight Amalek

items.quote: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.
items.claim: Moses says that the next day he will stand on top of the hill holding the rod of God.
items.mechanism: standing on the hilltop holding the rod of God during the battle
